**Important: YOU MUST USE subagents when available for the task.**

Stack: Laravel 12/PHP 8.2+, React 19/TypeScript, Mantine 7.17/Tailwind 4, Inertia 2 SSR, Filament 3.3, SQLite/multiple DBs, Vite 6, PHPUnit 11.5, Pint/ESLint/Prettier, Ziggy, Carbon. Use full-stack SPA, SSR, typed integration, separate Filament admin, Breeze auth, HMR/concurrent server. Subagents: Backend, React, UI/UX, API, reviews, performance, full-stack, Filament, authentication, database, state, testing (`<REDACTED_USER>` as available).

Tasks: `backlog/tasks/`; drafts: `backlog/drafts/`; docs: `backlog/docs/`; decisions: `backlog/decisions/`. Every implementation decision starts with reading the corresponding Markdown task file. All task operations should be done via Backlog.md CLI tool, this will correctly update the metadata in the task files and keep the project in sync. NO OPERATIONS SHOULD BE DONE MANUALLY ON THE TASK FILES.

**Always use `--plain` flag** when listing or viewing tasks for AI-friendly text output instead of using Backlog.md

Ask questions if unclear/ambiguous; split large work. Use a clear brief title, concise purpose/goal (no implementation details or code), and measurable checkbox outcomes. ACs must be outcome-oriented, testable/verifiable, clear, concise, complete, and user-focused.

Create files as `task-<id> - <title>.md`. Break features into atomic, testable, independent single-PR tasks in dependency order; identify foundations first. **Never** reference tasks that are to be done in the future or that are not yet created. You can only reference tasks (id < current task id). When creating multiple tasks, ensure they are **independent** and they do not depend on future tasks.

Task sections: **Implementation Plan** (the **"how"**; add only after putting the task in progress and before work), **Implementation Notes** (approach, decisions, challenges, deviations; add after work), tests. **IMPORTANT**: Do not implement anything else that deviates from the **Acceptance Criteria**. If you need to implement something that is not in the AC, update the AC first and then implement it or create a new task for it.

Always ensure you have:
1. ✅ Marked all acceptance criteria as completed (change `- [ ]` to `- [x]`)
2. ✅ Added an `## Implementation Notes` section documenting your approach
3. ✅ Run all tests and linting checks
4. ✅ Updated relevant documentation

A task is **Done** only when **ALL** of the following are complete: AC fully checked; plan followed or deviations documented; automated unit + integration tests cover new logic; linter and formatter succeed; relevant docs updated; `## Implementation Notes` summarizes features, decisions/trade-offs, and modified/added files; self-review complete; status set via CLI (`backlog task edit <id> -s Done`); performance, security and licence checks green. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: Never mark a task as Done without completing ALL items above.

**Commands (use verbatim):**
```text
backlog task list -s "To Do" --plain
backlog task 42 --plain
backlog task edit 42 -a @{yourself} -s "In Progress"
backlog task edit 42 --plan "1. Analyze current implementation\n2. Identify bottlenecks\n3. Refactor in phases"
backlog task create "Refactor DB layer" -p 42 -a @{yourself} -d "Description" --ac "Tests pass,Performance impro
